founder.label: Founder's road
founder.title: Building from zero: Yolda.com.
founder.intro: We founded a B2B digital logistics platform in the first month of the pandemic. In five years it grew into a 102-person team with operations in two countries. What I learned on that road is the foundation of what I do in enterprises today.
founder.case1.title: A logistics platform, built from zero

founder.case2.title: Running Germany from Turkey

founder.case3.title: Three rounds, the Endeavor network
founder.case3.desc: We raised more than $10M over three rounds from leading venture investors, and I was selected as an Endeavor Entrepreneur in 2022.

talks.vol1.title: Thought Exercises on Artificial Intelligence Vol.1 - The Philosophy of Transformation
talk.industrial-revolution-internet-ai.t: Industrial Revolution, Internet, and Artificial Intelligence
talk.industrial-revolution-internet-ai.s: Three transformations, three worlds: machines changed muscle work, the internet changed access to information, and AI is changing how we decide and produce.
talk.industrial-revolution-internet-ai.k: Labour: from muscle to knowledge work, and now to automated cognitive tasks.
Speed: the industrial age spread slowly; AI is digital, invisible and fast.
Power: every wave created new leading countries, companies and fortunes.
Today: adapting is how you survive; leading the change is how you make a difference.
talk.solopreneurship.title: One-Person Giant: Solopreneurship
talk.solopreneurship.subtitle: Solo Entrepreneurship in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
talk.solopreneurship.summary: With AI, one person can do what used to take a team, from marketing and sales to content and customer support.
talk.solopreneurship.k1: Cost: start-up costs drop; one person with the right tools can reach a global market.
talk.solopreneurship.k2: Niches: personalised products for markets where big companies struggle.
talk.solopreneurship.k3: Freedom: AI takes the routine work, so the founder can focus on strategy and creativity.
talk.solopreneurship.k4: Reality check: isolation, motivation and constant learning are still the hard parts.
talk.ai-agent-organizations.title: Next-Generation Organization with AI Agents
talk.ai-agent-organizations.subtitle: The Cards Are Being Reshuffled
talk.ai-agent-organizations.summary: AI agents can turn hierarchies into fluid, task-based teams where people and agents work side by side.
talk.ai-agent-organizations.k1: Efficiency: agents run analysis, reporting, customer contact and supply chains with little human input.
talk.ai-agent-organizations.k2: Decisions: faster, data-driven calls, while people focus on strategy and creativity.
talk.ai-agent-organizations.k3: New roles: managing, supervising and developing agents becomes a core skill.
talk.ai-agent-organizations.k4: Guardrails: privacy, security and accountability need clear policies.
talk.corporate-memory.title: Corporate Memory in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
talk.corporate-memory.subtitle: Whoever Owns the Data, Owns the Future
talk.corporate-memory.summary: An organisation's experience, knowledge and past decisions are its memory, and AI can finally make that memory usable.
talk.corporate-memory.k1: Unlocking data: emails, reports and meeting notes become searchable knowledge.
talk.corporate-memory.k2: Breaking silos: people find what they need fast and share it across teams.
talk.corporate-memory.k3: Corporate amnesia: less knowledge walks out the door, but biased data can still mislead.
talk.corporate-memory.k4: Strategic asset: companies that manage data as an asset will shape the future.
talks.vol2.title: Thought Exercises on Artificial Intelligence Vol.2 - Transformation of Sectors
talk.ai-in-finance.title: The Transforming Intelligence of Finance with AI
talk.ai-in-finance.subtitle: Making Sense of Data is Now Very Easy
talk.ai-in-finance.summary: Making sense of financial data is now easy, and that changes trading, risk, service and the products themselves.
talk.ai-in-finance.k1: Trading: algorithmic strategies, robo-advisors and personalised portfolios.
talk.ai-in-finance.k2: Risk: real-time fraud detection and faster, more accurate credit scoring.
talk.ai-in-finance.k3: Operations: credit applications, compliance (RegTech) and documents, automated.
talk.ai-in-finance.k4: Caution: bias, privacy and cybersecurity are the regulatory front line.
talk.retail-silent-revolution.title: Retail's Silent Revolution
talk.retail-silent-revolution.subtitle: An Unmanned Experience in the Age of AI
talk.retail-silent-revolution.summary: Retail is changing quietly: every customer gets their own store, and the store increasingly runs itself.
talk.retail-silent-revolution.k1: Personalisation: recommendations, promotions and content tailored to each customer.
talk.retail-silent-revolution.k2: Supply chain: demand forecasting that cuts both excess stock and stockouts.
talk.retail-silent-revolution.k3: Smart stores: cashierless checkout, dynamic pricing and AR try-ons.
talk.retail-silent-revolution.k4: Service: assistants handle FAQs and order tracking around the clock.
talk.ai-logistics-traceability.title: End-to-End Traceability in Logistics with AI
talk.ai-logistics-traceability.subtitle: Talking Agents, Control Towers, and More
talk.ai-logistics-traceability.summary: From the route to the warehouse to the shipment itself, AI makes logistics visible end to end, with talking agents and control towers.
talk.ai-logistics-traceability.k1: Routes: delivery plans that weigh traffic, weather, fuel and priorities.
talk.ai-logistics-traceability.k2: Warehouses: robots and AI-optimised layouts for stock and order picking.
talk.ai-logistics-traceability.k3: Live tracking: IoT sensors watch location, temperature and security, and flag problems early.
talk.ai-logistics-traceability.k4: Resilience: predicting disruptions and maintenance before they stop the chain.
talk.next-gen-ecommerce.title: Next-Generation E-Commerce: Next-Generation User Experience
talk.next-gen-ecommerce.subtitle: How Will the Transformation Started by the Internet Evolve with AI?
talk.next-gen-ecommerce.summary: The internet put shops online; AI makes every shop personal, conversational and visual.
talk.next-gen-ecommerce.k1: Hyper-personalisation: from homepage layout to recommendations, everything adapts to you.
talk.next-gen-ecommerce.k2: New search: find products by photo or by voice.
talk.next-gen-ecommerce.k3: Shopping assistants: chatbots that advise on style and guide the purchase.
talk.next-gen-ecommerce.k4: AR: try furniture, clothes or make-up in your own space before you buy.
talks.vol3.title: Thought Exercises on Artificial Intelligence Vol.3 - The Human-AI Relationship
talk.new-role-of-humans.title: The New Role of Human in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
talk.new-role-of-humans.subtitle: HR 4.0: How Should Humanity Transform?
talk.new-role-of-humans.summary: Jobs are transforming, not disappearing, and the skills that make us human are becoming more valuable.
talk.new-role-of-humans.k1: Human skills: critical thinking, creativity, empathy and ethical judgement.
talk.new-role-of-humans.k2: Collaboration: people make the strategic calls using what AI produces.
talk.new-role-of-humans.k3: Lifelong learning: reskilling becomes part of every career, and using AI tools becomes a basic skill.
talk.new-role-of-humans.k4: HR 4.0: HR leads the shift through training, development and culture.
talk.ai-software-development.title: The Rise of Artificial Intelligence in Software Development
talk.ai-software-development.subtitle: Line by Line Change: Will AI Eat Software Development?
talk.ai-software-development.summary: AI writes, reviews and tests code; the developer's job moves up to design, architecture and supervision.
talk.ai-software-development.k1: Generation: assistants write routine code and even whole functions.
talk.ai-software-development.k2: Quality: AI finds bugs, security holes and performance issues, and generates the tests.
talk.ai-software-development.k3: Natural language: requirements written in plain language become working software.
talk.ai-software-development.k4: The developer: not replaced, but freed for creative, complex and strategic work.
talk.ai-customer-experience.title: The New Era of AI-Powered Customer Experience
talk.ai-customer-experience.subtitle: From First Contact to Loyalty: Will an Unmanned Experience Satisfy?
talk.ai-customer-experience.summary: From first contact to loyalty: AI makes service instant, proactive and personal, while people handle what needs a human.
talk.ai-customer-experience.k1: Always on: personalised answers 24/7, without the wait.
talk.ai-customer-experience.k2: Proactive: problems are spotted and solved before the customer calls.
talk.ai-customer-experience.k3: Empathy: sentiment analysis senses frustration and adjusts the tone.
talk.ai-customer-experience.k4: Stronger agents: AI takes the routine work and gives human agents instant answers.
talk.ai-design-creativity.title: The Impact of Creativity's New Partner in the Design World
talk.ai-design-creativity.subtitle: Has the Place Where Dreams Begin Become More Important?
talk.ai-design-creativity.summary: AI is creativity's new partner: it generates endless variations, while concept and vision become the designer's real work.
talk.ai-design-creativity.k1: Inspiration: countless variations across styles to spark new ideas.
talk.ai-design-creativity.k2: Automation: logos, palettes and layouts as a starting point, not the finish.
talk.ai-design-creativity.k3: Speed: rapid prototyping and data-driven choices shorten every iteration.
talk.ai-design-creativity.k4: The designer: from maker to curator and director; intuition and taste still lead.

project.ai-code-reviewer.title: AI-Assisted Code Review
project.ai-code-reviewer.oneliner: A system that generates a dedicated code-review agent for every project: it scores code on six dimensions and catches blocker and critical issues before they reach production.
project.ai-code-reviewer.lead: Generic AI review finds generic issues. This system generates a reviewer for every project and proves each finding with a file and a line.
project.ai-code-reviewer.hero_fig: a review in seven steps: generate → learn → fan out → prove → verify → score → report
project.ai-code-reviewer.stat1_label: blocker & critical issues caught before production
project.ai-code-reviewer.stat4_label: to generate a project's own reviewer
project.ai-code-reviewer.c1.label: The problem
project.ai-code-reviewer.c1.title: Lots of noise, real risk lost.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c1.body: Hundreds of style comments bury the real risk, an authorisation gap. Management can't see the true health of the code.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c2.label: The generator
project.ai-code-reviewer.c2.title: One command, a reviewer made for the project.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c2.body: The generator scans the repos, matches each module to its stacks, has the team confirm, and produces a ready-to-install plugin.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c2.note: get it right once, repeat it everywhere.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c2.fig: from one command to a ready-to-install plugin
project.ai-code-reviewer.c2.fig_parts: project context|stack map|orchestrator|reviewer agent|scoring rules|report template|tracker skill
project.ai-code-reviewer.c3.label: Context
project.ai-code-reviewer.c3.title: Learn before you judge.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c3.body: The reviewer reads the project's context first, then loads the checklists for the module's stacks. Security is always on.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c3.note: the biggest jump in quality came from here.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c3.fig_context: architecture & call chains|auth decisions|data integrity & business rules|known issues|severity anchors
project.ai-code-reviewer.c4.label: The review
project.ai-code-reviewer.c4.title: One reviewer per module, all in parallel.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c4.body: One reviewer per module, in parallel; big modules are split across helpers. Every finding must point to a file:line.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c4.body2: Then every blocker and critical line is read again. What doesn't hold up is marked "unverified".
project.ai-code-reviewer.c4.fig: one review run, as you scroll
project.ai-code-reviewer.c5.label: Scoring
project.ai-code-reviewer.c5.title: Six dimensions, honest weights, anchored severity.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c5.body: Six weighted dimensions. A blocker needs all three conditions, and a single blocker caps the module at 1.5.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c5.note: otherwise every model calls everything critical.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c5.fig: dimensions and weights · the blocker test
project.ai-code-reviewer.c5.fig_not_bloc: Not a blocker: look one level down
project.ai-code-reviewer.c6.label: The result
project.ai-code-reviewer.c6.title: Visible risk, measurable quality.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c6.body: 800+ blocker and critical issues caught before production. Findings flow into the issue tracker, and management sees every project on one scale.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c6.note: one page for management, one line for the team.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c6.fig: module × severity heat map (one sample review)
project.ai-code-reviewer.c7.label: What I learned
project.ai-code-reviewer.c7.title: Context beats cleverness.
project.ai-code-reviewer.c7.body: Context matters more than the prompt. Severity needs anchors. Verification is a must. The generator carries the right logic to every project.
project.ai-code-reviewer.stack: Claude Code, plugin generator, skills, subagents, 19 technology checklists, Markdown reports, issue-tracker integration
project.ai-gateway.title: Enterprise AI Gateway
project.ai-gateway.oneliner: One governed front door for every AI model and tool in the company: single sign-on, per-person budgets, audit logs.
project.ai-gateway.lead: Hundreds of people want Claude, GPT and their own agents at work. Handing out API keys neither scales nor stays safe. We designed the layer in between: one control point.
project.ai-gateway.note: no one reaches a model directly.
project.ai-gateway.hero_fig: one front door instead of many
project.ai-gateway.stat1_label: control point for every model and tool
project.ai-gateway.c1.label: The problem
project.ai-gateway.c1.title: Personal keys, invisible cost.
project.ai-gateway.c1.body: Keys handed out by hand, settings on every laptop, no central view.
project.ai-gateway.c1.note: who uses what, at what cost?
project.ai-gateway.c1.fig_issues: No single sign-on|Keys handed out by hand|No budgets or limits|No logs or visibility|Tool access unmanaged
project.ai-gateway.c2.label: Architecture
project.ai-gateway.c2.title: The journey of a request.
project.ai-gateway.c2.body: Identity is verified; the gateway routes the request to an approved model, enforces the budget and logs it.
project.ai-gateway.c2.note: every call enters through one door.
project.ai-gateway.c2.fig: consumer → identity → gateway → model or tool
project.ai-gateway.c3.label: Tiers
project.ai-gateway.c3.title: Everyone gets what they need.
project.ai-gateway.c3.body: The role comes from the company directory; each tier sees different models, tools and budget.
project.ai-gateway.c3.note: switch the tier, watch the doors.
project.ai-gateway.c3.fig_tier_descs: Chat and approved tools|Bigger budget, more tools|Coding agents and the widest model list
project.ai-gateway.c4.label: Quotas
project.ai-gateway.c4.title: Quotas need layers.
project.ai-gateway.c4.body: Each layer catches a different failure; alerts fire at 75% and 90%.
project.ai-gateway.c4.fig_layers: Per-minute burst|Monthly personal budget|Department pool|Client soft limit|Capacity ceiling
project.ai-gateway.c5.label: Evolution
project.ai-gateway.c5.title: Four designs, one architecture.
project.ai-gateway.c5.body: It took four iterations to get it right; the last one is the single control point.
project.ai-gateway.c5.note: a single control point can be a single point of failure.
project.ai-gateway.c5.fig_iters: Cloud API manager only|Self-hosted gateway|Edge in front of the API manager|Edge AI gateway as the single control point
project.ai-gateway.c6.label: The result
project.ai-gateway.c6.title: AI for everyone, without losing control.
project.ai-gateway.c6.body: Employees sign in with their company account; security sees every call, finance tracks cost, IT adds new models without touching clients.
project.ai-gateway.c6.note: metadata first; content only after legal review.
project.ai-gateway.stack: Cloudflare AI Gateway & Access, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure AI Foundry, Azure API Management, MCP, managed settings, Terraform, Bicep, SIEM
project.executive-kpi-agent.title: Management Insights Agent
project.executive-kpi-agent.oneliner: An AI analyst for a holding company's executive board: ask why a KPI is off, and within minutes it brings back the root cause, with the numbers.
project.executive-kpi-agent.lead: The "why" questions before a board meeting used to wait days in an analyst queue. Now the board asks, the agent consults the company's data, and the answer arrives in minutes.
project.executive-kpi-agent.hero_fig: one question, one KPI tree, one root cause
project.executive-kpi-agent.c1.label: The problem
project.executive-kpi-agent.c1.title: The board saw numbers, not causes.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c1.body: Dashboards showed fixed views; every new "why" meant an analyst request and days of waiting.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c2.label: Architecture
project.executive-kpi-agent.c2.title: The board asks; the agent consults the company's data.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c2.body: The assistant reaches a secure server over MCP, and through it pre-computed summary tables. Only fixed, tested tools.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c2.note: out of scope? "I can't answer that yet."
project.executive-kpi-agent.c2.fig_cant: "I can't answer that yet" → logged for weekly review
project.executive-kpi-agent.c3.label: The KPI tree
project.executive-kpi-agent.c3.title: From EBITDA down to a single cost line.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c3.body: Every KPI is a node in a tree; the agent follows the gap from the top down.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c3.note: click a node to open it.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c4.label: Root cause
project.executive-kpi-agent.c4.title: From question to root cause, in five steps.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c4.body: Scenarios are compared, the gap is split by country, channel and category, and the right method is chosen.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c4.note: the figure shows the method, not the numbers.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c4.fig_metho: Gap closing|Price-volume-mix|Cost mix|Unit cost|Currency effect|Pricing & discounts|Regional volume
project.executive-kpi-agent.c4.fig_answe: The gap sits mainly in one country and one category; the driver is volume, not price.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c5.label: The result
project.executive-kpi-agent.c5.title: Minutes instead of an analyst queue.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c5.body: The board asks its own questions; everyone sees the same numbers, and analysts spend their time on real analysis.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c5.fig: the data model: before and after
project.executive-kpi-agent.c6.label: What I learned
project.executive-kpi-agent.c6.title: In finance, trust beats flexibility.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c6.body: Fixed tools and an honest "I can't answer that yet" earn more trust than free-form SQL. Most of the work is in the data model.
project.executive-kpi-agent.c6.note: we wrote the questions with the board.
project.executive-kpi-agent.stack: Claude, MCP server, Power BI / business-intelligence data, Azure API Management, Azure Functions (Python), summary tables, Entra ID
project.mailbox-qa.title: Mailbox RAG Agent
project.mailbox-qa.oneliner: Chat with an archived mailbox: plain-language questions, grounded answers, and every claim linked to its source email.
project.mailbox-qa.lead: When someone leaves, their mailbox becomes a black box. Auditors and successors need answers, not a 10 GB file. This proof of concept makes a mailbox something you can ask.
project.mailbox-qa.hero_fig: from a closed box to a cited answer
project.mailbox-qa.c1.label: The problem
project.mailbox-qa.c1.title: Knowledge locked in a departed mailbox.
project.mailbox-qa.c1.body: Keyword search finds words, not answers; reading thousands of threads by hand doesn't scale.
project.mailbox-qa.c2.label: Ingest
project.mailbox-qa.c2.title: Ingest once.
project.mailbox-qa.c2.body: The mailbox is cleaned, chunked, de-duplicated and turned into a searchable index.
project.mailbox-qa.c2.note: one message can carry a whole thread.
project.mailbox-qa.c3.label: Ask
project.mailbox-qa.c3.title: Ask anytime, get the answer with its sources.
project.mailbox-qa.c3.body: The eight most relevant passages are retrieved; the model answers with inline citations, or says it isn't there.
project.mailbox-qa.c3.note: click a citation to see the email.
project.mailbox-qa.c3.fig: an answer and its sources (invented example)
project.mailbox-qa.c3.fig_q: What was the final decision on the vendor contract?
project.mailbox-qa.c3.fig_answer: The contract was extended for two years [1], with the price increase capped at 3% [2].
project.mailbox-qa.c4.label: Production
project.mailbox-qa.c4.title: The data stays inside the company.
project.mailbox-qa.c4.body: In production, embeddings run on local models; the same pipeline scales to hundreds of mailboxes.
project.mailbox-qa.c4.fig: from proof of concept to production
project.mailbox-qa.c4.fig_rows: 1 MB → 10 TB|9 emails → ~50M|Cloud embeddings → local embeddings|Terminal → authenticated API|+ re-ranking, job queue, incremental sync
project.mailbox-qa.c5.label: What I learned
project.mailbox-qa.c5.title: Email is messier than documents.
project.mailbox-qa.c5.body: De-duplication matters as much as retrieval. Citations aren't decoration; they're where trust comes from. Design for "not found" from day one.
project.mailbox-qa.c5.note: if the auditor doesn't trust it, it's useless.
project.mailbox-qa.stack: Python, readpst/libpst, LangChain text splitters, embeddings (cloud → local), ChromaDB → Qdrant, Claude via MCP
project.player-support-agent.title: Player Support Agent
project.player-support-agent.oneliner: An AI support agent for mobile app and game studios: on every channel it recognises the user, understands the issue, and resolves it with approved actions.
project.player-support-agent.lead: When something breaks, studios react too late, and an unanswered 1-star review becomes public damage. This agent meets users wherever they show up, understands them and resolves the issue.
project.player-support-agent.note: resolves the safe cases, asks approval for the sensitive ones.
project.player-support-agent.stat2_label: steps: identify, understand, resolve, escalate, signal
project.player-support-agent.stat3_label: to a real answer, not days
project.player-support-agent.c1.label: The problem
project.player-support-agent.c1.title: Revenue moments create support moments.
project.player-support-agent.c1.body: When a purchase doesn't arrive, users expect an instant fix; most studios juggle a separate tool for every channel.
project.player-support-agent.c1.note: nobody notices the app quietly deleted.
project.player-support-agent.c2.label: How it works
project.player-support-agent.c2.title: Five steps for every message.
project.player-support-agent.c2.body: It recognises the user, understands the intent, resolves what's safe, hands over the rest with context, and flags what repeats.
project.player-support-agent.c2.note: pick a message, follow its journey.
project.player-support-agent.c2.fig_mess: Paid for the starter pack, didn't get it|Can't log in after the update|The event reward never arrived|Crashes since v2.3|Playing every day for a year
project.player-support-agent.c3.label: Actions
project.player-support-agent.c3.title: Ready-made actions for app and game studios.
project.player-support-agent.c3.body: The agent doesn't just answer: it checks context, takes the approved action, and closes the loop.
project.player-support-agent.c3.note: anything sensitive goes through a human.
project.player-support-agent.c3.fig_app: Subscription → check and restore|Login → guided recovery|Release bugs → cluster, alert the product team|Reviews → public reply
project.player-support-agent.c3.fig_game: Purchase → receipt check, restore delivery|Reward → progress check, grant with approval|Event / pass → eligibility check|Account → check history, recover or escalate
project.player-support-agent.c4.label: Approval
project.player-support-agent.c4.title: The agent drafts, a human decides.
project.player-support-agent.c4.body: Sensitive actions land in the team's Slack: approve, reject or redraft.
project.player-support-agent.c4.note: trust is earned step by step.
project.player-support-agent.c4.fig_card: Purchase issue · 2★ · "Paid for the starter pack, didn't get it"
project.player-support-agent.c5.label: Channels
project.player-support-agent.c5.title: Mobile today, every touchpoint next.
project.player-support-agent.c5.body: It started with in-app chat, email and both stores; PC, console and community channels are next.

project.player-support-agent.c6.title: Not everything needs a model.

project.sam-ai.title: Sam AI · Habit Coach
project.sam-ai.oneliner: A habit coach you talk to: tell it what you did, and it logs, tracks and cheers you on. On the App Store.
project.sam-ai.lead: Habit apps fail when logging feels like homework. Sam turns it into a conversation: say "I drank five glasses of water", and it handles the rest.
project.sam-ai.hero_fig: one sentence, one filled square, one streak
project.sam-ai.stat1_label: actions Sam can take from a chat
project.sam-ai.stat3_label: laws of habit formation, built in
project.sam-ai.c1.label: The problem
project.sam-ai.c1.title: Not another list: a coach.
project.sam-ai.c1.body: Checklists work for a week; then logging becomes a chore and the app gets deleted.
project.sam-ai.c2.label: The approach
project.sam-ai.c2.title: Obvious, attractive, easy, satisfying.
project.sam-ai.c2.body: The four laws of habit formation, popularised by Atomic Habits, run through the whole app.
project.sam-ai.c2.note: no guilt, just a fresh start.
project.sam-ai.c2.fig: the habit loop, as Sam runs it
project.sam-ai.c2.fig_laws: Make it obvious|Make it attractive|Make it easy|Make it satisfying
project.sam-ai.c2.fig_law_descs: The AI writes reminders from your real streak|The monthly grid is a pleasure to fill|Logging is one sentence|Streaks are celebrated; a setback is a fresh start
project.sam-ai.c3.label: How it works
project.sam-ai.c3.title: From one sentence to an updated grid.
project.sam-ai.c3.body: The model calls one of 15 tools: create habits, log progress, show analytics, set reminders.
project.sam-ai.c3.note: the tool counts streaks, never the model.
project.sam-ai.c3.fig_msg: I drank 5 glasses of water today
project.sam-ai.c3.fig_actions: Create a habit|Log progress|Show analytics|Set a reminder|Add a tracker
project.sam-ai.c4.label: Cost
project.sam-ai.c4.title: Cost is a product feature.
project.sam-ai.c4.body: Daily resets, compact context and a turn cap cut tokens by about 60%.
project.sam-ai.c4.fig_layers: Daily reset|Compact context|4 steps per turn|Rate limits|Billing cut-off
project.sam-ai.c5.label: The result
project.sam-ai.c5.title: From idea to the App Store.
project.sam-ai.c5.body: Live with a subscription model, in six languages. The lesson: tools beat prompts, and tone matters more than features.
project.sam-ai.stack: Expo, React Native, TypeScript, Firebase (Functions, Firestore), Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI & Anthropic models, RevenueCat, push notifications
project.skill-marketplace.title: Skills Marketplace for Every Team
project.skill-marketplace.oneliner: One internal marketplace where every department installs AI plugins and skills built for its own work, in a single command.
project.skill-marketplace.lead: AI adoption stalls when every team writes prompts from scratch. We turned the company's know-how into installable plugins: a plugin per department, a skill per repeatable task.
project.skill-marketplace.c1.label: The problem
project.skill-marketplace.c1.title: Everyone used AI, everyone differently.
project.skill-marketplace.c1.body: Copied prompts, uneven quality, and no way to share what worked.
project.skill-marketplace.c1.note: six teams, six private prompt notebooks.
project.skill-marketplace.c1.fig: from scattered prompts to one shared shelf
project.skill-marketplace.c2.label: The structure
project.skill-marketplace.c2.title: Three layers: company, project, exception.
project.skill-marketplace.c2.body: Defaults live in the department plugin, project context in CLAUDE.md, exceptions in a project plugin.
project.skill-marketplace.c2.note: not everything should be a skill.
project.skill-marketplace.c2.fig_l1_desc: The company's defaults; installed once per machine.
project.skill-marketplace.c2.fig_l2_desc: In every repo: architecture, rules, vocabulary.
project.skill-marketplace.c2.fig_l3_desc: Only when the defaults would mislead.
project.skill-marketplace.c3.label: The marketplace
project.skill-marketplace.c3.title: A shelf for every department.
project.skill-marketplace.c3.body: From engineering to databases, security to product: skills for each department's real work.
project.skill-marketplace.c3.note: click a shelf to open it.
project.skill-marketplace.c4.label: Install
project.skill-marketplace.c4.title: One command to install, one to update.
project.skill-marketplace.c4.body: A team adds the marketplace once, installs its plugin, and starts using it.
project.skill-marketplace.c5.label: For everyone
project.skill-marketplace.c5.title: Not just for developers.
project.skill-marketplace.c5.body: Analysts, product teams and every employee use AI safely in their daily work.
project.skill-marketplace.c5.fig_bi: Requirements doc → analysis → model → report, approved at each step
project.skill-marketplace.c5.fig_securit: A read-only security scan for every PC, with a PDF report
project.skill-marketplace.c5.fig_product: Product manager, designer and analyst skills
project.skill-marketplace.c6.label: The result
project.skill-marketplace.c6.title: The company's know-how, in everyone's hands.
project.skill-marketplace.c6.body: A better method found by one team reaches everyone with a single update.
project.skill-marketplace.c6.note: adoption is a product, not a mandate.
project.skill-marketplace.c6.fig_values: Every team starts from the same good defaults|Newcomers work the company's way from day one|Good methods spread with one update|Privacy by design: telemetry counts tokens, not content
project.skill-marketplace.stack: Claude Code plugin marketplace, skills, agents, hooks, MCP, Git, semver, Cloudflare Workers
